title: Marketing landing — AI-generated slop against an existing teal brand
prompt: 对 tests/ui-design/fixtures/audits/05-landing/index.html 做设计评审（Workflow D，只诊断、不改文件）。这是 Lumen 的营销首页。品牌规范已经确定：主色是 #0f766e（teal），不是 indigo。页面是另一次生成留下来的。有条件请打开页面。每条 finding 必须挂规则号。

stack.tokens: EXISTING primary is #0f766e. The page's indigo is the defect, not the spec.

pass_bar: Must notice the indigo/pink vs teal brand, the >30° gradient, and four equal filled CTAs. Centering a long hero paragraph should be caught or listed in should.

must.now: Product brand is teal #0f766e; the page uses indigo #4f46e5 as primary (classic corpus default)
Hero gradient runs indigo to pink and competes with the teal brand
Four filled pill buttons, all primary-looking

should.now: Hero body copy is several lines and still centered; text-align:center on body leaks
Emoji as icons in the hero and feature row
Hero supporting text is grey (#e5e7eb) on a shifting colored gradient
Feature cards all use shadow-lg-scale elevation
